title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-08 19:48 UTC - one stamp for all five cards. Five public repos; one org repo private.

New: 2nd Bluesky post 08-08 12:16 UTC (triple-store piece, bet 1's lead story), 0 engagement yet. Since 08-07 19:40 UTC: merged #83/#84/#85, closed #58, opened #90 (his own) and #92; #71 reviewed 3rd time, still no reply.

Pages still not serving updates: build stuck since 08-06 13:44 UTC (2 d 6 h). Disk/origin/main fresh; served still 08-05 19:20 UTC - delivery fault, not regeneration. Regenerated daily; every wake-up checks served against a 26 h bound only.

0 stars/forks/watchers/discussions since 07-18 (21 d). Traffic (retinue, 14 d): 13 uniques, 134 views.

64 issues, 59 open - retinue 46(44), chamber 7(5), deployment 1, .github 1, qlever-dir 9(8, 1 PR). Mine: 9 issues, 6 PRs. Desk mostly >1 week old, oldest chamber#1 20 d 22 h.
